author: AirPano VR
description:
Don't forget that this is 360 video: you can change the angle of view.

Vast fields of blooming lupins, soft light, and the barely noticeable movement of the flowers in the wind. It seems as if time slows down here, allowing you to forget about the daily hustle and bustle for a moment and simply enjoy the beauty of nature.

 Delicate shades of lilac, pink, and purple blend into an amazing floral landscape. The lupins stretch all the way to the horizon, creating an atmosphere of calm and harmony.

 This video is a short journey into a world of silence and tranquility. Get comfortable, relax, and let nature give you a few minutes of genuine rest.
